summary.text: LaVanna Wrobley is the Republican candidate for Missouri State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Tracy McCreery.
A small business owner, she also ran for Missouri House District 99 in 2022.

paragraphs.text: LaVanna Wrobley's career experience includes being a business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she raised her family and built her small business in the St. Louis County area and that she and her husband Kirk have two children.
She was the Republican candidate for Missouri House District 99 in 2022, when Democratic incumbent Ian Mackey defeated her 65.5% to 34.5%.
Wrobley advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 24 on August 4, 2026.
In the survey, she listed K-12 education reform, improved reading outcomes, teacher preparation and compensation, and expanded education freedom for parents among her key messages.
